items.custom_note: Flattened lateral end of the scapular spine overhanging the shoulder joint, both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.custom_note: Narrow groove ringing the margin of the articular head (band at the edge of the fitted head sphere), both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.custom_note: Constricted ring of the shaft just below the tubercles, both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.custom_note: Small anterior prominence of the proximal humerus, medial to the intertubercular groove, both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.custom_note: Groove between the greater and lesser tubercles running onto the anterior shaft, both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.custom_note: Shallow oblique groove on the posterior shaft where the real radial nerve (with the deep brachial artery) spirals round, both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.custom_note: Pulley-shaped medial articular surface of the distal humerus, found as the surface facing the trochlear notch of the ulna; both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.custom_note: Rounded lateral articular eminence of the distal humerus, found as the surface facing the radial head; both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.custom_note: Non-articular medial (larger) and lateral projections of the distal humerus, both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.custom_note: Proximal posterior process of the ulna forming the point of the elbow (above/behind the trochlear notch), both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.custom_note: Concave articular notch of the proximal ulna (between olecranon and coronoid) gripping the trochlea; found as the ulnar surface facing the humerus; both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.note: bounded by teres minor (SRC_Z_TERES_MINOR_MUSCLE_R/_L), teres major (SRC_Z_TERES_MAJOR_MUSCLE_R/_L), long head triceps (SRC_Z_LONG_HEAD_OF_TRICEPS_BRACHII_R/_L), surgical neck of humerus (SRC_Z_HUMERUS_R/_L)
items.custom_note: Opening bounded by teres minor (above), teres major (below), long head of triceps (medial) and the surgical neck of the humerus (lateral); placed where the real axillary nerve passes through it and sized by rays to those parts; both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.note: bounded by teres minor, teres major, long head triceps (SRC_Z_TERES_MINOR_MUSCLE_*, SRC_Z_TERES_MAJOR_MUSCLE_*, SRC_Z_LONG_HEAD_OF_TRICEPS_BRACHII_*)
items.custom_note: Opening bounded by teres minor, teres major and the long head of triceps (lateral); placed where the real circumflex scapular artery passes through it; both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.note: bounded by teres major, long head triceps, lateral head triceps/humerus (SRC_Z_TERES_MAJOR_MUSCLE_*, SRC_Z_LONG_HEAD_OF_TRICEPS_BRACHII_*, SRC_Z_LATERAL_HEAD_OF_TRICEPS_BRACHII_*, SRC_Z_HUMERUS_*)
items.custom_note: Opening below teres major between the long head of triceps (medial) and the lateral head/humerus (lateral); placed where the real radial nerve (with the deep brachial artery) passes through it; both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Skeletal Framework > Bones and landmarks
items.note: bounded by brachioradialis (SRC_Z_BRACHIORADIALIS_MUSCLE_*), pronator teres (SRC_Z_SUPERFICIAL_HEAD_OF_PRONATOR_TERES_*), epicondyle line on SRC_Z_HUMERUS_*; floor brachialis/supinator
items.custom_note: Triangular hollow in front of the elbow: superior border the line between the epicondyles, lateral brachioradialis, medial pronator teres (apex where they meet), floor brachialis/supinator; drawn as a ~9 mm deep volume over the floor; both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Joints and Stabilizers > Shoulder joint complex
items.note: joint/disc not modeled; articulation of clavicle medial end with manubrium
items.custom_note: Capsule-like volume spanning the facing surfaces of the medial end of the clavicle and the clavicular notch of the manubrium (articular disc region), both sides.

items.section: Shoulder Joints and Stabilizers > Shoulder joint complex
items.note: joint itself not modeled; AC ligament + clavicle lateral end + acromion of scapula
items.custom_note: Capsule-like volume spanning the lateral end of the clavicle and the medial facet of the acromion, both sides (the acromioclavicular ligament over it is a real part and its own item, 32).

items.section: Shoulder Joints and Stabilizers > Shoulder joint complex
items.note: capsule, labrum, GH ligaments (articulating bones SRC_Z_HUMERUS_*, SRC_Z_SCAPULA_*)

items.section: Shoulder Joints and Stabilizers > Shoulder joint complex
items.note: functional interface between SRC_Z_SCAPULA_*, SRC_Z_SERRATUS_ANTERIOR_MUSCLE_* and posterior ribs
items.custom_note: Functional gliding plane (not a true joint) between the costal surface of the scapula/subscapularis and the serratus anterior on the posterior chest wall: a sheet half-way between subscapularis and ribs 2-8 over the scapula footprint, both sides.
